Weak: Water, Fire(Half)
Zhang Fei's eyes gleamed as he read Jin Yuan's status; despite being only a quasi-divine beast, her abilities were truly extraordinary, and he was eager to take her on as his beast contract.
Zhang Fei turned himself into a half-fox and stared at the hands of the golden Buddha statue, as he said.
"I know you're up there, Jin Yuan.
You don't need to hide from me; I don't mean any harm to you."
[Dodge to the side, Master!]
Zhang Fei was taken aback by Mei's shout, and he immediately dodged to the side.
*Bam*
A stone stalactite stuck where Zhang Fei was standing earlier, and he smiled seeing that because Jin Yuan was also able to hide her attack.
*Bam...
Bam...*
However, Jin Yuan attacked him continuously.
Although Zhang Fei couldn't see her attack directly, he had a god cheat in Mei's form, so he could dodge all of her attacks so easily.
*Bam...
Bam...
Bam... *
"Hey, stop your attacks, I already told you that I have no malicious intent towards you." Suddenly, Mei said something to him, and he tried to persuade Jin Yuan.
"Anyway, I know your cultivation can no longer increase; if you are willing to make a contract with me, I will take you to another realm, where you can resume your cultivation."
Sure enough, after Zhang Fei said that, Jin Yuan immediately stopped attacking him.
She appeared in the hands of the huge golden Buddha statue, and then she asked doubtfully.
"Are you really able to take me to another realm?"
Zhang Fei just smiled at her and asked Mei to open a portal to the Sky Jade Realm, and Jin Yuan's eyes immediately lit up as soon as she felt a gust of Qi from behind the portal.
Jin Yuan immediately ran towards the portal, but just as she was about to jump in, Mei immediately closed the portal, causing her to fall forward.
"You really are cunning, Jin Yuan." Zhang Fei chuckled at that and crouched down in front of her, who was rubbing her head.
"I will only take you to another realm if you are willing to make a contract with me, but don't worry, I will not treat you badly."
Jin Yuan looked at Zhang Fei doubtfully, especially since she didn't recognize Zhang Fei's fox bloodline, and she thought about his offer.
"If I really meant to be mean to you, I could have done it from the start, Jin Yuan." Zhang Fei then released a bit of his Heavenly Fox aura, but he quickly withdrew it again.
Even so, Jin Yuan was already trembling the moment she sensed his Heavenly Fox aura, even if it was only for a moment.
She then exclaimed in shock.
"You... you are a Mythical Rank Beast!"
"Actually, I am an ordinary human, but I am also a Heavenly Fox, Jin Yuan." Zhang Fei responded as he returned to his human form, gently caressing her head and saying sincerely.
"Become my beast contract; that way we can help each other be strong in the future."
"No!" Zhang Fei was dumbfounded; he didn't expect that Jin Yuan would reject him, and she then said.
"You have a snake smell on you, so I don't want to make a contract with you."
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed, and he didn't expect that Jin Yuan would reject him because of Boitata.
"How about you make a contract with one of my women?
That way, you'll still be part of my big family, and I'll take you to another realm later."
Jin Yuan thought for a moment, then she nodded in agreement.
"Fine, I'll take a look at them first, but if I feel that none of them are suitable to be my master, then you shouldn't force me."
"Okay, if none of them match your liking, then I'll bring you back to this place." Zhang Fei nodded, then he sent Jin Yuan into his beast space and went home.

chapters.title: Chapter 109: Guo Lan Kidnapped
paragraphs: Factory
"Guo Lan! A woman is looking for you, and she claims to be your relative!" A factory employee shouted from afar.

'A relative of mine? How is that possible? All my relatives are in another city.' Guo Lan inwardly wondered in confusion, but then she walked out to meet the person who claimed to be her relative. When she arrived outside the factory, Guo Lan immediately raised her eyebrows, and she asked the woman. "Who are you? I don't recognize you as my relative."
The woman just smiled at her, and suddenly another woman hit Guo Lan's nape from behind and knocked her unconscious. "Quickly put her in the car, and bring her to that place straight away."
The woman nodded; she immediately put the fainted Guo Lan into the black sedan, and the two of them immediately left the place.
About fifteen minutes later, the black sedan stopped in front of an empty warehouse, and the two women immediately brought Guo Lan inside.
And in the empty warehouse, there were already four people waiting for them, and one of the women asked. "What should I do with this woman, Brother Hong?"

"Tie her in the back room and cover her mouth with tape, Shi Wu." Chen Hong, who was sitting with a woman on his lap, ordered, and then he turned to Zhang He and Chen Xin. "Soon my men will be here, and after that we will contact Zhang Fei to come here."
"That woman is really beautiful, Hong. No wonder your friend is so infatuated with her." with a chuckle, the woman on Chen Hong's lap said.
Chen Hong then kissed the woman's lips for a brief moment before saying. "But she's not as pretty as you, Fu Min."

"You're really handsome and manly, Hong." Fu Min spoke as she wrapped her arms around Chen Hong's neck, then kissed his lips passionately. Zhang He and Chen Xin inwardly cursed at their shameless act.
Half an hour later, ten muscular men walked into the empty warehouse, and they were carrying lots of sharp weapons.
"Where's the guy we're going to kill, Boss?" One of the men asked.
"You guys are really impatient, huh?" Chen Hong said with a laugh, then he turned to Chen Xin. "Give Zhang Fei's cell phone number to Fu Min, and let her contact him."
Chen Xin immediately gave his cellphone number to Fu Min; she then walked into Guo Lan's room and took a photo of her, and sent the photo to Zhang Fei.
After that, Fu Min walked out of the room; she sat back on Chen Hong's lap, as she said. "It's done; I already sent the photo, but Zhang Fei's cell phone is still off."
*Tap... Tap...*
Suddenly, a man walked into the empty warehouse, and he excitedly asked. "Where is Guo Lan, Hong? I want to see her."

"Heh, you should wait until we get rid of Zhang Fei." Chen Hong stated sternly before pointing to the room where Guo Lan was being held. "Anyway, she's in there, but I warn you not to do anything to that woman for now. Otherwise, I'll beat you up myself, Hong Ming."
Hong Ming shuddered at Chen Hong's threat, then he walked toward the room. "Fine, it doesn't matter for me to wait; she will eventually be mine later."
Chen Hong and the others could only shake their heads at Hong Ming.

As soon as he entered the room, Hong Ming smiled widely at Guo Lan, who was still unconscious. He sat down beside her and caressed her cheek. "Hehe, after today, you will definitely be mine, and you can forget about that damn Zhang Fei, because he will definitely die today."
'This man is really creepy, Wu.' One of the two women guarding Guo Lan said.
Shi Wu nodded in agreement. 'He really is pathetic, Shi Xi.'
After a long flight, Zhang Fei finally arrived at his house, and he called his women to his room.
"Why did you gather us here, Big Brother?" Zhang Lin asked curiously, especially when she saw his mysterious smile.
Chu Qing, and Chu Ying were also curious about his purpose.

Zhang Fei laughed as he saw them, then let Jin Yuan out of his Beast Space. Chu Qing and Zhang Lin's eyes sparkled at Jin Yuan because she was so cute in their eyes, and then Zhang Fei explained. "Her name is Jin Yuan, and she is a quasi-divine beast, but she can become a divine beast in the future.
Originally, I wanted her to be my contract beast, but she refused to make a contract with me, so I brought her here to make a contract with one of you guys."
"But how can she exist in this realm, Fei? Obviously there is no qi in this realm." Chu Ying asked in confusion.

Zhang Fei turned to Jin Yuan, but she shook her head at him, then she explained. "Honestly, I don't know the reason myself, because when I came out of my egg, I was already in that place, and my cultivation has also been at this stage since then, but it has not increased again in these five hundred years."
"Huh? You were born from an egg?" Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin asked in shock.
Jin Yuan nodded and said it again. "I really was born from an egg, and the egg was also golden in color, but after I was born, I ate all the shells."
"You can't compare beasts to ordinary animals, Fei." Chu Ying said with a chuckle. "Beasts can be born in many ways, and that's what makes them unique."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "Are there any of them that you feel are suitable to be your master, Jin Yuan?"
Jin Yuan immediately jumped from Zhang Fei's lap, and she jumped on Chu Qing's head. "I want to make a contract with this little girl."
"Huh!?" Chu Qing was taken aback when she heard that, so she lifted Jin Yuan from her head and placed her on her lap, smiling happily. "Do you really want to make a contract with me?"
"Actually, you and she are suitable to be my master." Jin Yuan pointed at Chu Ying. "But you are the most suitable, so I decided to choose you as my master."

Chu Ying then rubbed her little sister's head. "Hurry up and make a contract with her, because beasts have strong instincts, and if Jin Yuan chooses you, it means that you are most worthy of being her master."

Chu Qing nodded, then she pressed her forehead against hers, and soon the contract between them was established. She laughed as she rubbed Jin Yuan's head after it was finished. "Thank you for choosing me as your master."
Zhang Lin then sat on Zhang Fei's lap, and she pouted. "You should also find me a contract beast, Big Brother."
"Hey, I'll definitely find all of you contract beasts, but you'll have to be patient to meet the one that suits you best." Zhang Fei said as he rubbed his little sister's head.
After they talked for a while, the women immediately came out of Zhang Fei's room. He then checked his smartphone but found that the battery was empty, so he immediately charged it.

Before long, Zhang Fei's face darkened as soon as he saw the photo sent by Fu Min, and he immediately dashed out. "I don't care who you are; since you've already challenged a demon like me, then don't blame me for being cruel to you."

chapters.title: Chapter 110: The Angry Demon
paragraphs: "Ugh!" Guo Lan who was unconscious, groaned softly. She slowly started to open her eyes, but she was instantly shocked when she found herself in an unfamiliar room, especially when she felt her hands were tightly bound and her mouth was plastered.

Guo Lan was even more shocked when she saw the man she hated the most sitting on the chair next to her, coupled with the presence of the two women who had kidnapped her; she looked at him hatefully as she inwardly cursed. 'Hong Ming! You bastard! I will never forgive you!'

"Hey, you don't have to look at me like that, Lan." Hong Ming said, then he caressed Guo Lan's cheek. "I won't touch you for now, because I still have to wait for Zhang Fei to come here, but after we get rid of him, then I will make you my woman."

'Fei? No! Please don't come here, Fei! I don't want anything to happen to you because of me!' Guo Lan could only scream in her heart, and she prayed that Zhang Fei wouldn't come for her as she continued to stare at Hong Ming coldly and hatefully.
Outside, Zhang Fei was hovering in the air above the empty warehouse, flapping his wings and staring at the empty warehouse with his blood-red eyes.

The map in front of his eyes also showed the names of the eighteen people who were in the empty warehouse; his gaze became extremely cold when he saw the names of four people who were very familiar to him, and a cruel grin appeared on his face as he muttered to himself. "It looks like they won't have given up before they met King Yama, huh."
After that, Zhang Fei landed in front of the empty warehouse, returned to his human form, and then casually walked inside.
*Clap... Clap...*

"I didn't expect you to actually come here, it seems you really are a loyal friend, huh?" Chen Hong clapped his hands when he saw Zhang Fei, but he was uneasy because of his calm and relaxed demeanor. 'How can he be that calm? What's more, he doesn't seem afraid in the slightest.'
"Heh, you will definitely die today, Zhang Fei!" Zhang He shouted at his little brother as he smiled triumphantly.
Unlike Zhang He, Chen Xin and Fu Min also felt uneasy seeing Zhang Fei's calmness, and they could clearly see that there was absolutely no fear in him. 'What happened? Does he really have no fear?'

"It looks like you're really looking forward to seeing King Yama, Zhang He." Zhang Fei nonchalantly said, then turned to Chen Hong. "You, Hong Ming, and your ten men will also accompany him to meet King Yama, Chen Hong."
Chen Hong and the others were flabbergasted by his words; they were shocked that Zhang Fei knew of their number, and he could even know Hong Ming's presence in Guo Lan's room.
"As for the four women." Zhang Fei paused for a moment, looking at Chen Xin and Fu Min, before saying with a vile grin. "Hey, you guys can see what I'm going to do with them later."

Chen Xin and Fu Min shuddered at his words, but then they calmed themselves down, and Fu Min snorted at him. "Humph! You're really good at bragging, Zhang Fei! All of them will definitely finish you off!"
After Fu Min said that, Chen Hong's ten men emerged from hiding and surrounded Zhang Fei with various weapons in hand, and one of the men asked. "Shall we start now, Boss?"
"Heh, don't kill him right away, and you have to torture him first for daring to threaten me." Chen Hong spoke and smiled broadly as he hugged and kissed Fu Min.
"Attack him!" One of them shouted, and the ten of them immediately attacked Zhang Fei.
But Zhang Fei just stood still, and he enveloped his body with a thin qi as he nonchalantly crossed his arms in front of his chest. "Sigh, a bunch of idiots!"
*Clang... Clang...*

"What the hell!?" Chen Hong cried out in shock as he got up from his seat when he saw his men's weapons stopped just one inch away from Zhang Fei's body, and he shouted at them. "Hey! What are you guys doing? Hurry up and beat him!"

"We can't, boss! Our weapons can't hit his body." They replied, their muscles bulging out as they tried to forcefully press their weapons against Zhang Fei's body; some of them had even used both hands, but their weapons still couldn't move forward.
"Move!" Chen Hong shouted as he took a gun from behind his waist, and he directly fired his gun at Zhang Fei twice. "Die! You bastard!"
*Bang... Bang...*
"Heh!" Zhang Fei just snorted and stretched out his hand covered in qi, and he caught the two bullets that Chen Hong shot at him.
Then he flicked the two bullets at Chen Hong and Zhang He; the two bullets shot fast towards them and pierced their thighs.
"Argh...!" Chen Hong and Zhang He fell to the ground, and they groaned in pain as they clutched their bleeding thighs.
"Husband!"
"Hong!"
Chen Xin and Fu Min exclaimed in shock, and they tried to help them, but they shivered at the sight of blood pouring out of their thighs, and they stared at Zhang Fei in horror.

The ten men were also shocked to see that; they fearfully looked at Zhang Fei, because not only could their weapons not injure him, but he could even catch the bullets that Chen Hong had fired earlier.
"Do you guys still think that I'm bragging now?" Zhang Fei, with a nonchalant shrug, asked, and before they could blink, he had already broken both of their legs.
*Bam... Bam...*
"Argh...!" The ten of Chen Hong's men fell to the ground and groaned in pain, as they stared in horror at Zhang Fei, because they couldn't even see him move.
'Fuck! He's a monster!' Chen Hong was inwardly cursing, and his body was shaking violently; so was Zhang Fe as well.
*Drap... Drap..."
Hong Ming and the two women, who listened to their cries of pain from within the room, immediately ran outside, and they were shocked when they saw the condition of those people.
"What-" Hong Ming had not finished shouting; Zhang Fei was already standing in front of him, and he tightly gripped his face.
Shi Wu and Shi Xi stumbled backwards, wide-eyed at Zhang Fei, as they were shocked that he was already standing in front of them.

"Hong Ming, huh? You're such an asshole, you even want to force Lan to be your woman!" After he said that, Zhang Fei directly hit his stomach with one heavy blow, and he also broke his legs. Then he threw him into the crowd.
*Bam*
"Guah...!" Hong Ming vomited a lot of blood from his mouth, and he was instantly passed out by the excruciating pain in his body and legs.
"Let go of Guo Lan right now and bring her to my side." As he had said to Shi Wu and Shi Xi, Zhang Fei turned to walk towards Chen Hong and the others.

Meanwhile, in a restaurant, two women are sitting together, enjoying the food in front of them, and they are having a small talk.
"Hey, Xue, is having sex with Fei really that satisfying?"
"You should try it yourself, and I'm sure you'll be addicted to it after you try it once." Ru Xue replied with a chuckle. "Anyway, have you decided about your relationship with Fei, Yan?"
Zhong Yan looked pensively at Ru Xue, and before long she nodded. "I decided to accept him, and since business is my area of expertise, I will also support him in his business."

"To be honest, Fei has too many women, and the number of women will probably continue to increase in the future. Sometime, it made me wonder whether he would be able to be fair to all of us or not." Ru Xue said with a low sigh.

Zhong Yan also realized that, but then she said. "Even though I've only known Fei for two years, I know he'll be fair to all of us. Actually, there is still one more woman, but Fei only considers her as his servant."
"Who?" Ru Xue was surprised to hear that, because she didn't know anything about it.
Zhong Yan smiled meaningfully at her, and she purposely replied by dragging her words. "She... is... Huang... Rong."
As Zhong Yan expected, Ru Xue was instantly shocked as soon as she heard Huang Rong's name, and before long she shouted. "Are you joking with me, Yan?"
"I'm not joking with you." Zhong Yan laughed softly at her reaction, then she explained everything to Ru Xue from the beginning, and Huang Rong's decision led him to accept Zhang Fei's offer.

Ru Xue burst out laughing after hearing everything. She knew that Huang Rong was a very respectable woman, but behind all that, it turned out that she was a sex maniac. "Haha! This is the most ridiculous news I've ever heard in my life. I didn't expect that a respectable woman like her would be willing to serve a demon. But it's also good for Fei, and he can use her for his business interests."
"I agree with you." Zhong Yan said with a nod, and then they talked about the plan to go out with Zhang Fei tonight, as well as about some other things.

"What the hell is going on? Why did Huang Rong suddenly stop supporting me?" Zhang Hai wondered in his heart after he read the messages from her, even though he had tried to contact her many times but she kept ignoring his calls. "Damn it! Zhong Yan has decided to stop cooperating with me, and she is now also doing this to me!"
After that, Zhang Hai tried to contact several other people, but they also ignored his calls. "Fuck! At this rate, my company will really collapse!"
After thinking for a few moments, Zhang Hai left the room.

When Zhang Fei arrived at Guo Lan's house, she was already anxiously waiting for him in front of her house, and she immediately ran to hug him, then rubbed her face against his chest. "I'm happy to see you, Fei."
"Hey, you're acting like Ling'er, Lan." Zhang Fei said with a chuckle as he hugged and caressed Guo Lan's back. "You can rest easy now; Hong Ming will never bother you again after this."
"En." Guo Lan only answered with a nod and sniffed his body; then she looked up at him and asked with a frown. "Do you have any other women besides Sister Xue, Fei?"
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed and answered her worriedly. "To be honest, I have too many women, Lan. Besides Xue, I still have my five official women, and I also have three unofficial women."
Guo Lan froze upon hearing that; she broke away from Zhang Fei's embrace, then looked at him in complete shock, and tears flowed from her eyes.
"Lan-"
"I hate you, Fei!" Guo Lan shouted at him with a broken heart, then she turned back into her house as she slammed the door of the house really hard.
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed, and he realized that he had hurt Guo Lan's feelings, but he also couldn't keep lying to her; sooner or later he had to confess to her the truth.
[Why don't you use your demon charm on her, Master?] Mei asked in confusion.

'Sigh, her feelings are very sincere to me, Mei. So I don't want to spoil it with my demon charm.' Zhang Fei then walked away, and he turned his head for a moment towards Guo Lan's house. "Lan, I'm sorry for hurting your feelings, but I will never force you to accept my situation, and I hope that you will find another man who is much better than me."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately walked away, and he returned to his grandmother's house.

Inside her house, Guo Lan was sitting on the floor behind the door; she buried her face into her knees, and she kept crying to shed her sadness. "Why? Why did you turn into a playboy now, Fei? I really love you wholeheartedly, but I don't want to share you with other women."
When he arrived at his grandmother's house, Zhang Fei immediately called Qing Yi, Zhang Lin, and Zhang Chen because he did not want to hide Zhang He and Chen Xin's deaths from them.
Zhang Chen raised her eyebrows at her grandson's expression, and she asked. "What do you want to tell us, Fei'er."
Zhang Fei looked at them and took a deep breath, then he told them the truth. "Zhang He and Chen Xin are dead, and I was the one who killed them."
"What!?" Qing Yi and Zhang Chen screamed in shock at the same time, and they stared at Zhang Fei in disbelief. As for Zhang Lin, she smiled happily at the news of Zhang He's death.
Zhang Chen leaned against the back of the sofa, as she disappointedly asked. "Why did you kill him, Fei'er? He is, after all, your big brother."

Hearing that, Zhang Chen and Qing Yi sighed in their hearts, and they couldn't say anything to him.
The Chu Sisters, who were listening to their conversation, immediately came out of the room.
Chu Ying then said to them. "Grandma Chen, Aunt Yi, I hope you two don't blame Fei for killing them, especially since they wanted to kill him first."
"I know, I'm just sad that things turned out like this." Zhang Chen sighed, then stood up and spoke again. "Let me calm myself down first."
"Me too." Qing Yi also returned to her room; after all, Zhang He was also her son, so she also felt sad knowing her second son had killed his big brother.
Chu Ying then said to him. "Fei, you shouldn't blame them."
"No, I don't blame them." Zhang Fei replied with a shake of his head; he himself also knew that they must be grieving over Zhang He's death.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [1] was strolling around the Yin-Yang Pavilion accompanied by Luo Yu and Gu Yan. Since he had only joined their sect for a day and he didn't know anything about it, the two women took him around to show him the sect's area.

The two women sighed helplessly at his question, and the Yin-Yang Pavilion was indeed like a brothel. "Actually, this place used to be a prostitution area in the Southern Continent, but after the Shen Clan ancestors took over this place, they turned this place into the Yin-Yang Pavilion.
Even though those prostitutes have long since disappeared, the traditions persist within the sect; some of the elders of this sect are even descendants of those prostitutes."
"Oh? Their ancestors didn't change the rules of this place? And they keep it like this?" Zhang Fei was quite surprised to hear that.

"Yes." Gu Yan nodded to him. "Even though they can do as they please within the sect, they are still bound by the rules made by the Shen Clan's ancestors. According to the sect rules, an outer disciple can only choose one dual cultivation partner, an inner disciple can now choose two partners, and a core disciple can choose three partners."
"Hmm? Then what about you guys? Aren't you two my dual cultivation partners now?" Zhang Fei [1] asked as he raised his eyebrows.

Luo Yu answered him. "The sect's rules were made like that to prevent a commotion between the disciples, but our situation is different from other disciples', so it doesn't matter if the two of us become your dual cultivation partners."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding and smirked faintly; he didn't care about the rules of the sect, and he would definitely look for other women who were willing to be his dual cultivation partners.
Noticing his smirk, Gu Yan asked him. "Do you still want to find other women to be your dual cultivation partner?"
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her as he spoke. "You two can't even last long enough to dual cultivate with me, right? Of course, I have to find some other women to be my dual cultivation partners."

The two women's faces reddened upon hearing that; they themselves were too exhausted after dual cultivating with him yesterday. If he wanted to do it with them every day, then they wouldn't be strong enough to serve him.

"I have some recommendations of a few women who can be your dual cultivation partner." Luo Yu then warned him, "However, you must do it in secret, or the sect master will punish you if you have other partners besides us."
"Oh? Tell me their names." Zhang Fei [1] really couldn't wait to get some other dual cultivation partners to increase his cultivation.
Luo Yu and Gu Yan exchanged glances for a moment, and then they mentioned a few women who might be suitable to be his dual cultivation partners.

Zhang Fei [1] listened to them as he checked his map for the locations of the women they mentioned, and he found several women who were suitable to be his dual cultivation partners. 'Interesting! I will meet them one by one later.'

The two women then explained their sect to him. Like other sects, the Yin-Yang Pavilion also has the Mission Hall, Armory Hall, Treasure Hall, Book Hall, and Medical Hall. And most importantly, the Yin-Yang Chamber.
From the outside, the Yin-Yang Chamber looks very luxurious, but not many people can enter it.
"Fei, if you want to enter the Yin-Yang Chamber, then you must become an inner disciple, and you must also enter the top 10 inner disciples first." Lou Yu explained it.
Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "I thought it wouldn't be difficult for me to become an inner disciple, but to get into the top 10, I probably have to put more effort into it."
"Yes, I believe it won't take long for you to become an inner disciple." Guo Yan said as she nodded. "However, we may become inner disciples before you."
"It doesn't matter, right? Even though the two of you became inner disciples earlier than me, you guys are still my dual cultivation partners." Zhang Fei casually said.
"Yes." The two women nodded at him; since they had dual cultivated with him, it was impossible for them to find other partners because the satisfaction of doing so with him was extremely great.
Mei suddenly said to him. [I detected an item under the Yin-Yang Chamber, Master.]
'Oh? Do you know what kind of item it is, Mei?' Zhang Fei was really curious about it.
[Based on the data in the system, it is a middle-grade Qi vein, and it is right in the middle of the chamber.]
Zhang Fei raised his eyebrows. 'Middle-grade Qi vein? What is that?'

[Master, Qi Veins are world veins that produce Qi. If the vein is covered with a formation like in the Yin-Yang Chamber, then the Qi generated by the vein will be focused inside the formation, which is why the Qi inside the chamber is much richer and denser than the outside.]
'Do you think I can steal it?' Zhang Fei was really interested in it, and he wanted to use it in his portable mansion.

Mei laughed at his question. [Well, you can steal it, but you can't do it now, Master. Moreover, you just joined the sect yesterday, and you don't have the privilege to enter the Yin-Yang Chamber yet.]
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. 'All right, then, I'll work hard to become an inner disciple and make it to the top 10, so I can enter the Yin-Yang Chamber, and I will steal it in the future.'

However, Zhang Fei [1] suddenly gave a faint smile, looking at his map, and he saw a name following them. 'Aiyo, I've been waiting for her for two days, and that Shi Yue finally couldn't hold herself back anymore.'
[Hehe, master, that Shi Yue is quite interesting. Even though her mental strength is very weak, she can withstand the effects of your demon charms for a long time.]
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with Mei. 'It's okay, she will eventually fall into my hands, and I can use her to harvest female essence.'

On the other hand, Shi Yue, who was flying slowly, shook her head at their closeness. 'Sigh, it's been two days, and I've been trying to hold myself back, but I can't hold back the urge to get closer to him anymore. However, I didn't expect that he already has four partners; if that senile old man finds out about their relationship, then he will expel him from the sect, and I can't let that happen.'

Meanwhile, a young woman kneeled in front of the middle-aged woman, who was reading a book, and reported. "Madam Huan, ous spies informed me that Chu Ying has returned to the Chu Clan, and the Liu Sisters are busy with their own business, so there is no one to protect her now."
"What about our spies in Hua Luo?" Huan Ning asked.
The young woman answered her directly. "Currently, the Wen Twins are out with that young man, so there's no one to guard Hua Luo, and we can immediately put your plan into action."

"Yes, madam." Gui Yin then disappeared from Huan Ning's presence.
Huan Ning then leaned back in her chair and took out a placard with Zhang's name written on it. "As long as he has some connection with the Zhang Clan, then I will definitely destroy him."
Hua Luo

Two women sneaked into the water source in Hua Luo and poured some liquid into it, and soon the water source was contaminated with the liquid. However, before they left the place, the two women swallowed a pill.
"Hey, the people in this place will definitely suffer." one of the women said.
The other woman nodded in agreement. "Unfortunately, we can't leave this brothel for now, and we have to make sure the Wen Twins drink the water from this place first."
After that, the two women immediately left the location of the water source, and they informed Gui Yin.

chapters.title: Chapter 121: Essence Absorption Technique
paragraphs: "Why are you so eager to hunt beasts, Zhang Fei?" Wen Yuan asked as she looked at the countless beast corpses under the foundation realm strewn across the ground.

Since his cultivation was already at the 5 Star Foundation realm, combined with his Demon Physique Strengthening Method and teleportation ability, it was very easy for Zhang Fei to kill various kinds of beasts under the Foundation realm.

Zhang Fei continued to search for the beast cores in the heads of the beast corpses as he answered her questions. "To be honest, I need a lot of beast cores for something, and that's why I'm so eager to hunt them."
Wen Xuan then asked. "How many beast cores do you need?"
"I need 5,000 lower-grade beast cores." With a low sigh, Zhang Fei answered her.
"Hmm?" The Wen Twins were surprised to hear that; they then checked their storage ring and gave all their lower-grade beast cores to Zhang Fei.
Zhang Fei's eyes lit up after receiving them all, for there were so many of them. 'Count them, Mei.'
[Okay!]
Female Essence: 800
Beast Essence: 16,500
Red Jewels: 1,501,470
Green Jewels: 10,000
Blue Jewels: 5,000
Lower Grade Beast Cores: 6150
Intermediate Grade Beast Cores: 510
Advanced Grade Beast Cores: 10
Sect Points: 2,000
'Oh? Over 6,000 beast cores!' Zhang Fei cheered in his heart upon seeing that. 'Mei! Immediately buy that Essence Absorption Technique!'
[Alrighty!]
{You got Essence Absorption Technique x1}
{5000 Lower Grade Beast Core has been deducted from your balance}
Unlike his cultivation technique, Zhang Fei doesn't need to learn the abilities of his demon and beast bloodlines, and he can already use all of his techniques instantly.
"Why did your expression suddenly become so happy?" Wen Yuan asked after seeing the smile on his face.
Zhang Fei laughed and hugged the Wen Twins by the waist, then he kissed them on the lips for a moment before answering them. "Let's find a stronger beast first, and I'll show you guys later."
"Hmm?" The Wen Twins stared at him in confusion.
They then moved to another part of the forest, and soon they encountered a wild boar beast at Core Rank, and the Wen Twins helped Zhang Fei restrict its movements with their auras.
Actually, they didn't need to do that to help him because Zhang Fei could do it himself. Just by releasing a bit of his heavenly fox's aura, the beasts would definitely tremble before him.
Zhang Fei immediately moved in front of the beast, pressed his palm against its head, and used his new technique on it.
*Snort... Snort...*
The wild boar beast groaned in pain and screamed as he did that, and Zhang Fei could feel its essence flowing into his body rapidly.
The Wen Twins' eyes widened, and their jaws dropped as they saw the beast's body dry up quickly, and soon only its skin and bones were left.
[You gained 1,000 Beast Essence from Wild Boar Beast.]

"Damn! I didn't expect that technique to be terrifying enough!" Zhang Fei shouted in shock; he himself did not expect that the effect of his new technique was similar to that of life-force absorption.

Mei giggled and explained it to him. [Master, beast essence is no different from human life force, so the effects of the two techniques are indeed similar. But isn't this great? This way, you can collect beast essence quickly, and your second tail can grow even faster.]
'Well, that's true; I really can't wait to grow my second tail.' Zhang Fei replied with a slight nod.
"Fei! What kind of technique is that?" Wei Yuan asked as she frowned at him.
Wen Xuan's expression was also ugly after witnessing his vicious actions. "Where did you learn such a cruel technique?"

"Have you guys forgotten that I'm also a fox beast?" Zhang Fei asked back and looked at them in amusement, and the Wen Twins didn't forget that either. "It's one of my beast abilities, but I can only use it against beasts."
"Really? Can you really only use that technique on beasts?" The Wen Twins simply did not believe his words.

Zhang Fei nodded and explained it to them. "As a human, I need qi to increase my cultivation. But as a fox beast, I need a lot of beast essence to evolve. So I was forced to use that technique, or else it would take me a very long time to evolve."
"I see." Wen Yuan nodded in understanding. "I know that a beast can evolve, but I've always thought that they only need qi to do so."
"I also know that beast was like that." Wen Xuan said.
"Hey, don't compare me to normal beasts." Zhang Fei chuckled. "Let's go; I want to find more beasts, for I still need so many beast essences."
The Wen Twins couldn't help but shake their heads, and they immediately followed Zhang Fei.
Meanwhile, the four women who were with Zhang Fei [1] were also shocked to see him absorbing the beast essence, especially since the beast dries up quickly.
Unlike the other three women, Luo Yu, as a beast, noticed his actions, and her body trembled at the thought of Zhang Fei [1] doing that to her. 'How could he do that? He absorbed its essence dry.'
[You gained 1,500 Beast Essence from the Snake Turtle Beast.]

After the beast died, Zhang Fei [1] breathed a sigh of relief, and he nodded to himself with a satisfied smile. Then he turned to Luo Yu and said to her. "Hey, you are my partner, so of course I would never use my technique on you."
"But where did you get the technique that can absorb the beast essence from other beasts?" Luo Yu asked with a frown.
Even though Zhang Fei [1] had said it like that, Luo Yu still couldn't shake off the anxiety in her heart, and she was scared if he suddenly used that technique on her.
Zhang Fei [1] laughed softly and gave her a fake answer. "That is one of my innate abilities, and I need a lot of beast essence to evolve."
"Wait a minute!" Gu Yan suddenly shouted after she realized something, and she turned to Luo Yu. "Does that mean you're a beast?"
Luo Yu sighed softly and nodded to her. "Yan, I'm sorry. I never told you before, but I am indeed a beast."
Ning Xiang and Duan Yu were also surprised to hear that; they certainly knew that beasts could turn into humans, but they didn't expect that one of them would be among them.
Zhang Fei [1] then said to Gu Yan. "Even though Luo Yu is a beast, it shouldn't matter to you, right?"
"En, I was just surprised to hear that." Gu Yan replied as she nodded.
Luo Yu breathed a sigh of relief at her answer, for she already felt very close to her.

chapters.title: Chapter 122: Killing Gui Yin
paragraphs: While Zhang Fei was busy in the forest with the Wen Twins, and the other women were also busy with his shop and restaurant, a woman sneaked into the Chu Clan with great care.

The woman was none other than Gui Yin, and she only had one goal, which was to kidnap Chu Ying. 'Hmm? She was in that formation, but there were too many people around her, so I had to distract the others' attention first.'
Unfortunately, Gui Yin was not aware that someone was aware of her presence. 'Master! There is a woman sneaking into this clan.'
'Hmm? Is that true, Jin Yuan?'
Jin Yuan nodded to Chu Qing, and she glanced in the direction where Gui Yin was hiding. 'That woman is hiding in that place.'
Since they have a contractual bond, both of them can communicate easily, and no one can eavesdrop on their conversation.

'What is the purpose of that woman infiltrating here? Moreover, mom and Aunt Hua aren't here right now.' Chu Qing wondered in her heart as she glanced at Gui Yin carefully. 'Can you sense that woman's cultivation?'
'Her cultivation is at the 10-Star Core Realm.' Jin Yue answered as she nodded.

Chu Qing frowned upon hearing that, and she glanced at her big sister, who was still oblivious to Gui Yin's presence, but their cultivations were also below hers. 'Can you do something about that woman?'
'Hehe! It was so easy for me.' Jin Yuan then used her clone, and she also used her stealth. 'Master, you just wait here. I'll capture that woman first.'
'Be careful, Jin Yuan.'
'All right.'
Jin Yuan then moved swiftly towards Gui Yin, and soon she was already behind her, but she could not feel her presence.
Even Zhang Fei couldn't detect Jin Yuan's whereabouts while she was in stealth without Mei's help, let alone Gui Yin.
Jin Yuan smirked and used her earth art, and a big stone appeared in her hands.

"Ugh!" Gui Yin groaned in pain as Jin Yuan slammed the stone in her hand against the nape of her neck hard, and she fell unconscious. (A/N: In case you guys forgot, you can re-read Chapter 111 - The Golden Monkey.)
"Master! I've paralyzed this woman!" Jin Yuan shouted as she undid her stealth, startling Chu Ying and the others.
"What happened, Qing'er?" Chu Ying asked in surprise after hearing Jin Yuan's shout.
"A woman sneaked in here, and Jin Yuan has already paralyzed her." Chu Qing answered as she stood up, and she dashed to their location. "Let's go there, Big Sis."
Chu Ying, Zhang Lin, and Xu Ling'er immediately followed behind her.
When they got there, Chu Yin immediately squatted beside the fainted Gui Yin, and she sealed her cultivation right away.
On the other hand, Chu Qing immediately took Gui Yin's storage ring and kept it, and she then checked her clothes to look for her identity.
"Hmm? Gui assassin?" Chu Qing spoke in surprise after she found Gui Yin's plaque.
"Do you know about Gui assassin, Big Sis? Why did she infiltrate this clan?" Zhang Lin asked.

Chu Ying was silent and tried to search her memories about them, but then shook her head. "I've never heard of Gui assassin before, nor do I know her purpose in infiltrating here, but Aunt Hua might know something about it."
After that, Chu Ying ordered several people to tie up Gui Yin, and she also ordered them to gag her mouth with a thick cloth so that she wouldn't commit suicide.
Then Chu Ying informed Zhang Fei, Liu Hua, and Liu Qingyu about him.
Forest

After he listened to Chu Ying's voice transmission, Zhang Fei, who was sucking the beast essence from a beast, raised his eyebrows. "Xuan'er! Yuan'er. Do you two know anything about that Gui assassin?"
Wen Xuan answered him directly. "Big Sis Hua suspects that the Gui assassin is related to the Zhao Clan, or to be more precise with Huan Ning, the mistress of that clan."
"What happened? Why are you asking about them?" Wen Yuan curiously asked him.
[You gained 2,000 Beast Essence from the Two-Headed Jackal.]

After the beast died, Zhang Fei then withdrew his hand and turned to the Wen Twins. "Just now Ying'er sent me a voice transmission, and she told me that a woman from the Gui assassins infiltrated the Chu Clan. Fortunately, Jin Yuan noticed her presence directly, and she had already immobilized her."
"Huh?" The Wen Twins were completely shocked to hear that; they did not expect that a member of the Gui Assassin would infiltrate the Chu Clan in their absence.

Wen Yuan then told him. "The two assassins who tried to kill you back then also came from the Gui assassin, and if it's true that they are related to the Zhao Clan, I think the target of that woman is Chu Ying."

"Gui assassin, Zhao Clan, I see now." Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he nodded in understanding after he analyzed everything. "If Hua'er's conjecture is true that they are indeed related to each other, then it's no wonder they wanted to kill me, and Huan Ning did everything for the sake of her son."
"That's right!" Wen Xuan agreed with him. "Everyone in town also knows that Zhao Yun likes Chu Ying so much; he and Ye Hang have always competed to win her heart, but now she has become your wife."
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and smirked slightly, then hugged the Wen Twins by the waist. "Since it's almost dark, let's go back to the Chu Clan first, and I will do something about that woman."
After saying that, Zhang Fei took the Wen Twins away from the forest by teleporting.
Chu Clan
When they arrived at the main hall, Gui Yin had already opened her eyes, and the Liu Sisters were facing her.
After they got Chu Ying's voice transmission, Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu immediately returned to the Chu Clan, and they tried to interrogate Gui Yin.
"How is it, Hua'er?" Zhang Fei asked as he glanced at Gui Yin.
Liu Hua sighed softly. "She doesn't want to open her mouth."

"I see." Zhang Fei then crouched down in front of Gui Yin and clutched her face, and his eyes turned blood-red after he activated the demon eyes, causing her to shiver in horror. "Let me tell you one thing: I am not as patient and kind as them, so you better tell me the truth about Huan Ning's plans. Otherwise, I will cripple your cultivation, and I will allow some beasts to violate you by force."
Not only Gui Yin, but even the Liu Sisters and the Wen Twins were terrified after they heard his words.
Under the influence of Zhang Fei's demon eyes, Gui Yin finally confesses to him all of Huan Ning's plans, shocking them.
Then the Wen Twins rushed back to Hua Luo to capture Huan Ning's spies, and the Liu Sisters also moved to capture her spies within the clan.

After that, Zhang Fei used Life-Force Absorption on Gui Yin, and he sucked her life energy clean. Unfortunately, the technique didn't give him any female essence, and he immediately burned her corpse to dust.

'All right.'
Jin Yuan then moved swiftly towards Gui Yin, and soon she was already behind her, but she could not feel her presence.
Even Zhang Fei couldn't detect Jin Yuan's whereabouts while she was in stealth without Mei's help, let alone Gui Yin.
Jin Yuan smirked and used her earth art, and a big stone appeared in her hands.

"Ugh!" Gui Yin groaned in pain as Jin Yuan slammed the stone in her hand against the nape of her neck hard, and she fell unconscious. (A/N: In case you guys forgot, you can re-read Chapter 111 - The Golden Monkey.)
"Master!
I've paralyzed this woman!" Jin Yuan shouted as she undid her stealth, startling Chu Ying and the others.
"What happened, Qing'er?" Chu Ying asked in surprise after hearing Jin Yuan's shout.
"A woman sneaked in here, and Jin Yuan has already paralyzed her." Chu Qing answered as she stood up, and she dashed to their location.
"Let's go there, Big Sis."
Chu Ying, Zhang Lin, and Xu Ling'er immediately followed behind her.
When they got there, Chu Yin immediately squatted beside the fainted Gui Yin, and she sealed her cultivation right away.
On the other hand, Chu Qing immediately took Gui Yin's storage ring and kept it, and she then checked her clothes to look for her identity.
"Hmm?
Gui assassin?" Chu Qing spoke in surprise after she found Gui Yin's plaque.
"Do you know about Gui assassin, Big Sis?
Why did she infiltrate this clan?" Zhang Lin asked.
Chu Ying was silent and tried to search her memories about them, but then shook her head.
"I've never heard of Gui assassin before, nor do I know her purpose in infiltrating here, but Aunt Hua might know something about it."
After that, Chu Ying ordered several people to tie up Gui Yin, and she also ordered them to gag her mouth with a thick cloth so that she wouldn't commit suicide.
Then Chu Ying informed Zhang Fei, Liu Hua, and Liu Qingyu about him.
Forest

"Xuan'er!
Yuan'er.
Do you two know anything about that Gui assassin?"
Wen Xuan answered him directly.
"Big Sis Hua suspects that the Gui assassin is related to the Zhao Clan, or to be more precise with Huan Ning, the mistress of that clan."
"What happened?
Why are you asking about them?" Wen Yuan curiously asked him.
[You gained 2,000 Beast Essence from the Two-Headed Jackal.]
After the beast died, Zhang Fei then withdrew his hand and turned to the Wen Twins.
"Just now Ying'er sent me a voice transmission, and she told me that a woman from the Gui assassins infiltrated the Chu Clan.
Fortunately, Jin Yuan noticed her presence directly, and she had already immobilized her."
"Huh?" The Wen Twins were completely shocked to hear that; they did not expect that a member of the Gui Assassin would infiltrate the Chu Clan in their absence.
Wen Yuan then told him.
"The two assassins who tried to kill you back then also came from the Gui assassin, and if it's true that they are related to the Zhao Clan, I think the target of that woman is Chu Ying."
"Gui assassin, Zhao Clan, I see now." Zhang Fei muttered to himself as he nodded in understanding after he analyzed everything.
"If Hua'er's conjecture is true that they are indeed related to each other, then it's no wonder they wanted to kill me, and Huan Ning did everything for the sake of her son."
"That's right!" Wen Xuan agreed with him.
"Everyone in town also knows that Zhao Yun likes Chu Ying so much; he and Ye Hang have always competed to win her heart, but now she has become your wife."
"Heh!" Zhang Fei snorted and smirked slightly, then hugged the Wen Twins by the waist.
"Since it's almost dark, let's go back to the Chu Clan first, and I will do something about that woman."

When they arrived at the main hall, Gui Yin had already opened her eyes, and the Liu Sisters were facing her.

Not only Gui Yin, but even the Liu Sisters and the Wen Twins were terrified after they heard his words.
Under the influence of Zhang Fei's demon eyes, Gui Yin finally confesses to him all of Huan Ning's plans, shocking them.
Then the Wen Twins rushed back to Hua Luo to capture Huan Ning's spies, and the Liu Sisters also moved to capture her spies within the clan.

Unfortunately, the technique didn't give him any female essence, and he immediately burned her corpse to dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 123: Hu Lili
paragraphs: In a garden, a woman with white hair is sitting on a swing. Her slender body looks perfect in a long white dress with floral prints; she has a beautiful curve, and her assets are quite big.

However, the woman is no ordinary woman, because she has fox ears, and there are five fox tails behind her hips. She had a seductive and alluring face, with two slanted black eyes adorned by thick white eyebrows, a beautiful slender nose, and thin lips covered in red lipstick.

Without looking back, the woman gently asked the person walking up to her. "You haven't been back in a long time, Yue'er. How was your adventure in the outside world? Did you find anything interesting?"
The person who approached the woman was none other than Hu Yue, the Moon Fox. She then stood beside the woman and answered. "En, I found a lot of interesting things, Mother."
"Oh? Would you mind telling me what you found during your adventure?" The woman asked, as she turned to her daughter, and the woman's name was Hu Lili.

"En." Hu Yue nodded, then she started to tell her mother many things, and her mother just silently listened to her stories. After quite a while, she sighed softly. "I also met a male fox, but he's not a moon fox like us."
"Hmm?" Hu Lili raised her eyebrows as she looked at her daughter questioningly, as she had never met another fox race in the Sky Jade Realm.

Hu Yue shook her head and then explained. "I don't know his exact race, Mother. Even though his cultivation is much lower than mine, I feel an unusual vibe from him, and I feel my bloodline is very suppressed when he's around me. Moreover, even though he doesn't do anything to me, I feel an urge to submit to him, and it comes from my bloodline."

Hu Lili was really surprised to hear that, because the Moon Fox was the strongest beast in the Sky Jade Realm, but they had never been directly involved in the affairs of the Sky Jade Realm, and no other beast had been able to suppress their bloodline before.
But now, her daughter said that there was another fox race that could suppress her bloodline, and she also felt the urge to submit to Zhang Fei because of her bloodline.
"Have you heard of any other fox race that is stronger than our Moon Fox race, Mother?" Hu Yue curiously asked, because her mother had far more knowledge than her.

Hu Lili did not immediately answer her daughter's question; she seemed lost in her own thoughts, and her expression changed several times at the thought of her daughter's words. Before long, she frowned and looked at her daughter seriously. "If what you say is true, then there is only one fox race that can suppress our bloodline, Yue'er."
"What's the fox race?" Hu Yue asked impatiently; after meeting Zhang Fei, she kept feeling curious about his true identity, as he still hadn't revealed much about himself to her.

Hu Lili sighed softly, then she looked up at the sky and replied. "I once read about a legend in our race; it was written about one fox race being the highest of all the fox races, and that race was the Heavenly Fox."
"Heavenly Fox?" Hu Yue was surprised to hear that, as she had never known about it before.

"En." Hu Lili nodded to her. "In the legend, the Heavenly Foxes are the most arrogant, haughty, cunning, and cruel of all the fox races. But their character is not without reason, because they are indeed the strongest, and they are also the only fox race that can reach the ten tails."

"Ten tails!" Hu Yue let out a low cry, then she said in disbelief. "Is that true, Mother? But I've never heard of a fox that can reach the ten tails before; it's not even easy for us to reach the nine tails."

"I don't know about the truth either." Hu Lili replied with a shake of her head. "But if he can really suppress your bloodline without doing anything, then there's no mistaking that he's a Heavenly Fox."
Hu Yue was momentarily stunned by her mother's words, as she muttered to herself. "No wonder he feels so confident that he can snatch me away in five years."
"Hmm? What do you mean by those words?" Hu Lili asked with a raised eyebrow.

Hu Yue found it difficult to tell her mother, but finally she made up her mind; then she lifted her dress slightly and showed a pink heart symbol under her navel, as she said. "He asked me to be his partner, and this pink heart is his mark. He purposely gave me his mark to fight back against Hu Gao's mark, but he didn't explain to me in detail about this mark."

Hu Lili was dumbfounded by her daughter's confession, and her eyes were fixed on the pink symbol below her navel. She then reached out her hand to rub the pink heart symbol, as she asked. "Do you fall in love with that male fox? And what's his name?"

"His name is Zhang Fei." Hu Yue replied without hesitation. "I fell in love with him the first time I met him, and he feels the same way about me. He also promised me that he would come here in five years to snatch me from Hu Dong."

Hu Lili looked at her daughter in surprise, and she never expected that her daughter would fall in love with a male fox during her adventure, but she also knew that she had never loved Hu Dong from the start, and their engagement was forced by Hu Gao. Before long, she sighed softly and asked her again. "Do you believe that he will come here in five years?"
"En, I believe in him." Hu Yue replied confidently. Although she didn't know Zhang Fei well, she felt that he was a man who always kept his words.

Hu Lili immediately got off the swing, faced her daughter, and then caressed her cheek, as she said with a smile. "If you really love that male fox, then I will support you, and I hope that he will keep his promise to you."
"En, thank you, Mother." Hu Yue said with a happy smile.
After they talked about some other things, Hu Yue immediately said goodbye to her mother, and she headed to her own cave to do long seclusion.

"Western Region, huh? It seems that I have to go there to meet that male fox named Zhang Fei, and if he really is a Heavenly Fox, then only he can save Yue'er from Hu Gao." Hu Lili muttered to herself, after which she disappeared from the garden instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 124: Killing Spies
paragraphs: After the Liu Sisters found all the spies in their clan, they immediately killed them.

On the other hand, the Wen Twins brought two beauties with them, and Wen Xuan explained it to Liu Hua. "Big Sis, the two of them have poisoned Hua Luo's water sources, but fortunately there weren't many people there yet, so there were only a few casualties."
The two women looked at Liu Hua fearfully, especially since they knew very well her reputation in the past.

However, Liu Hua didn't say anything to her, and she turned to her husband. "What are you going to do with them, Fei'er? Do you want to give them to your body double? And your body double can use them as cultivation furnaces."

The two women trembled violently at the thought of their bodies being used as cultivation furnaces, and they really didn't want that to happen to them, but they were powerless before strong cultivators like Liu Hua and Liu Qingyu.
"No." Zhang Fei rejected her idea.
Since his body double and him were one entity, and he could also feel what his clone felt, Zhang Fei didn't want his body double to dual cultivate with a whore like them.
*Rawr*
Suddenly, they heard a small roar. Soon the two tigresses ran into the main hall, and they rubbed their heads playfully against Zhang Fei's feet.
"They are of no use to me, so just give them to the beasts in the forest, and they will surely enjoy eating them alive." Zhang Fei said as he rubbed the heads of the two tigresses.
The Wen Twins, the Liu Sisters, and the two women were in shock at his words.

Even though they were still small, the two tigresses possessed high intelligence and understood the meaning of Zhang Fei's words, and they stared at the two women fiercely as if they wanted to eat them up.

"Hey, now, their meat isn't good for you two." Zhang Fei said with a chuckle, seeing the reaction of the two tigresses, he then took some beast meat from his inventory and gave those meats to them, and the two immediately ate them excitedly.
After that, Zhang Fei grabbed the shoulders of the two women and carried them away using his teleportation. And minutes later, he had reappeared in the main hall.
"Are you really giving those two women to the beasts in the forest, Fei'er?" Liu Qingyu asked.
Zhang Fei immediately answered her without the slightest regret. "Yes, they must have been eaten alive by that lion beast."
They were speechless for a while, and Liu Hua then asked. "So what's your plan with Huan Ning?"

"Do you know the depths of the Gui Assassin and the Zhao Clan's strength?" Liu Hua shook her head, because she didn't know about it, and they were also supported by the other two powerful clans. "In that case, we don't need to bother them for the time being, but I won't just let Huan Ning go, especially since she tried to kill me and tried to kidnap Ying'er."
The four women were stunned to hear that, but they felt a bad feeling after seeing his devilish smile. 'It seems he is plotting something heinous against them.'
After they chatted for a while, the Wen Twins immediately returned to Hua Luo to clean up the water source, and they decided to close their premises for a few days.
As for Liu Qingyu, she went to see Zhu Yan to talk about the opening of Zhang Fei's restaurant tomorrow morning.

Zhang Fei and Liu Hua immediately went to the bathing pool, and the other women were already waiting there, except for Zhang Chen and Xu Ling'er, who were still cultivating in the qi gathering formation in the back garden.
Chu Qing directly climbed onto his lap. "Fei, since I've already broken through to the Core Realm, I want to do it with you right away."
"All right, we'll do it tonight in your room, okay?" Zhang Fei unhesitatingly agreed to her request, especially since Chu Qing was already his wife.
While they were soaking, Zhang Fei did not engage in sexual activity with his women, and they only talked about light things, mainly about preparations for opening his shop and restaurant.
Meanwhile, in a forest, after they hunted various beasts and completed their group's mission.
A man and four women went to a small stream, and they hastily stripped off their clothes before throwing themselves into it, washing away the blood and dirt from their bodies.
They were Zhang Fei [1], Gu Yan, Lou Yu, Ning Xiang, and Du Yuan.
Zhang Fei [1] leaned against a boulder and asked. 'Mei, how much more female essence and beast essence do I need to break through to the next stage?'
[Wait a minute, master.]
Demon Rank:
> Lesser Rank [Female Essence: 5,800/10,000]
Beast Rank:
> 1 Tail [Beast Essence: 35,000/50,000]
'Hmm? 4,200 female essences and another 15,000 beast essences.' After reading that, Zhang Fei [1] muttered to himself with a low sigh.
[Apparently, your beast rank will break through before your demon rank, master.]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with her. 'You're right, especially since I can absorb the beast essence using my essence absorption technique. Unfortunately, my Life-Force Absorption Technique didn't give me female essence, or else my demon rank could have increased faster.'

[Anyway, master, I think you should focus on getting the female essence as soon as possible; that way, you can upgrade your demon body double to level 2. If you can create your second body double, you can use it to find more partners and accelerate your progress.]

Zhang Fei [1] also wanted to do that as soon as possible, but the problem was that those women could only give him 100 female essences every time they orgasmed, and he couldn't keep forcing them to have sex with him or they would die of exhaustion. 'What do you think if I go to the Netherworld Realm, Mei? I believe I can obtain a large amount of female essence from the female demons in that realm.'

[You are absolutely right about that, master. You will get more female essence if you have sex with them, but I don't recommend you go to that realm for now. First, the demons in the Netherworld Realm were much stronger than the cultivators in this realm.
Second, you have only transformed for four days (Earth time) or nine days (SJR time), so I don't think you are ready to go there, and it would be best if you train and cultivate in this realm first.]
Zhang Fei [1] sighed as he realized he was still too weak, and he relied too heavily on his heavenly fox bloodline to subdue the beasts, as well as his teleportation to avoid the opponent's attack.
[Don't you want to eat the woman hiding up in the tree right away, master?]
"Hey, Shi Yue! I know you've been following us since early morning, so you better come down and join us." Zhang Fei [1] shouted toward her hiding place, startling the four women.
Soon, Shi Yue jumped down from the top of the tree. She glanced briefly at the four women before asking him. "So you deliberately lured me to this place?"

chapters.title: Chapter 132: Reunion I
paragraphs: The following day, Zhang Yue, sitting in the car with Janette, looked really impatient to get to their destination, and she even kept telling the driver to drive the car faster.
"Calm down, Yue!" Janette finally said in a slightly raised voice; she was annoyed to see Zhang Yue acting like a child.

Hearing her voice, Zhang Yue fell silent. She clasped her hands in front of her chest and trembled excitedly as she muttered in her heart. 'Finally, I will be able to meet you soon, Fei! I've really missed you during these two years!'
'Sigh, this woman! She says she doesn't love her little brother yet acts like a woman who can't wait to meet her lover!' Janette grumbled in amusement and looked at Zhang Yue while shaking her head.

After a long journey, they finally arrived at Zhang Chen's house, but Zhang Yue immediately frowned when she saw three young women in traditional clothes practicing martial arts and a golden monkey watching them while eating bananas from the side.

Janette also looked at the three young women in surprise; the three women were stunning in her eyes. But then she frowned; she felt a familiar aura emanating from their bodies. 'Damn it! How could there be cultivators on earth? As I recall, cultivators have long since left the earth, and there is no Qi left in this world.'

Without waiting for Janette, Zhang Yue immediately got out of the car, then ran in the direction of Zhang Chen's house, but she stopped in front of the three women and asked with a frown. "Who are you guys? Why are you guys at my grandmother's house?"
experience-MVLeMpYr
The three women looked at her, confused about Zhang Yue's identity, and Ye Lian then answered her. "My name is Ye Lian, and I am Zhang Fei's friend."
"I am Chu Qing, one of Fei's wives." She also answered, pointed to Chu Ying, and introduced her to Zhang Yue. "She is my eldest sister, and she is also his wife."

"Huh?" Zhang Yue was shocked by their confession, and she looked at them one by one. Involuntarily, her heart was filled with jealousy because she felt inferior to the three, especially Chu Ying, who was so beautiful and graceful.
"Who-"

"Big Sis!" Before Ye Lian finished asking, Zhang Lin had already shouted from inside, then she ran out of the house and hugged Zhang Yue while crying. "Sob... I... I really miss you, Big Sis! Sob... You're so mean!
Sob... You left me for two years. Sob..."
Ye Lian, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing were dumbfounded. They finally realized that the woman before them was Zhang Yue, Zhang Fei's big sister.
Zhang Yue's heart melted hearing her little sister's cry; she hugged her back and rubbed her back gently, as she said. "I'm sorry because I left you for these two years, Lin."
"I'm glad you're finally back here, Big Sis." Zhang Lin shook her head slightly as she hugged Zhang Yue tighter.
Before long, Qing Yi and Zhang Chen also came out of the house. Zhang Lin let go of her big sister's embrace and let her grandmother hug Zhang Yue.
As for Qing Yi, she looked at her eldest daughter complicatedly, she had a big fight with her two years ago, and tears welled up in her eyes.
"I miss you so much, Grandma." Zhang Yue spoke as she hugged her grandmother tightly. Her eyes then turned to her mother; she sighed softly and said. "I missed you too, Mom."
Qing Yi wiped her tears, walked over to Zhang Yue, and hugged her tightly, as she said. "I miss you a lot, Yue'er. I hope you will continue to live here in the future."
"En, I'll stay here, Mom. Because I'm moving to work in the next town." Zhang Yue answered quietly, and she also hugged Qing Yi tightly.

Janette just stared at them from afar, as she frowned even more because she could feel the same aura on Zhang Chen, Qing Yi, and Zhang Lin's bodies. 'Shit! How can there be so many cultivators in this place? And how come Yue's family also cultivators?'
While Zhang Yue was embracing Qing Yi, two other women arrived at Zhang Chen's house, and they were Zhong Yan and Ru Xue.
Ru Xuethen asked. "Yue? When did you come back here?"
Zhang Yue then let go of her embrace and turned to them. "Long time no see, Big Sis Xue, Big Sis Yan."
"I didn't expect you to want to come back here, Yue." Zhong Yan said with a smile.
Zhang Yue laughed softly. "It may be time for me to return, and my office just happens to move me to the next town."
"Oh?" Ru Xue and Zhong Yan were surprised to hear that.
Zhang Yue then turned to look for Zhang Fei because he still hadn't come out of the house. "Anyway, where's Fei, mom? Why hasn't he come out to see me yet?"
"Hmm? It seems Fei'er is still sleeping in his room." Qing Yi answered as she turned her head inside the house.
Zhang Lin added with a nod. "That's right, Big Sis. It seems Big Brother is still sleeping because he did many strenuous things yesterday, and maybe he is too tired now."
Zhang Yue nodded in understanding, then she turned to her best friend and called out. "What are you waiting for, Janette? Why are you just standing there?"

Zhang Chen, Zhang Lin, Qing Yi, Zhong Yan, and Ru Xue turned their heads towards Janette, who was standing in the distance. But since they were still novice cultivators, they couldn't recognize her identity.
As for Ye Lian, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing, they raised their eyebrows as soon as they saw Janette. At one glance, they could tell that she was not a human.

They exchanged glances and nodded to each other, then moved in front of Zhang Chen and the others as they exerted their Qi. Even Jin Yuan also jumped onto Chu Qing's head, and she also exerted her Qi.
Janette's expression became ugly seeing them like that, but she didn't look scared at all three of them, and her body was also covered in a blackish-green aura.
But before they could do anything, Zhang Fei shouted from inside. "Stop all your actions, and don't make a fuss in this place."

chapters.title: Chapter 133: Reunion II
paragraphs: Hearing Zhang Fei's voice, Zhang Yue then turned her head towards the entrance of the house, her eyes trembled when she saw him walking out, and involuntarily tears dripped from the corners of her eyes.
Ye Lian, Chu Ying, Chu Qing, and Jin Yuan immediately retracted their Qi, and they also looked at him.
Zhang Fei simply nodded to them, then walked over to Zhang Yue and stood before her, as he said with a heartfelt smile. "I miss you so much, Big Sis."
"Fei... I... miss you... so... much..." Zhang Yue said in a trembling voice, then hugged Zhang Fei very tightly, and she cried as hard as she could.
Zhang Fei sighed inwardly and then hugged his big sister, gently patting her back. "I'm glad you're doing well overseas."
"En." Zhang Yue nodded slightly, and a happy smile graced her face feeling the warmth of her little brother's body.
Zhang Chen, Zhang Lin, and Qing Yi smiled happily, seeing them like that. They knew they cared for each other a lot, and the two years apart made them miss each other very much.
Zhang Fei then glanced at Janette, who looked wary at him. 'Scan her, Mei.'
[Okay!]
Name: Janette
Age: 500+ Years Old
Gender: Female
Race: Dryad
Rank: Viscountess
Element: Wood, Darkness
Physique: Tree Demon
Abilities: Tree Control, Charm, Life Absorption, Shapeshifting
Strong: Wood, Water, Darkness
Weak: Metal, Lightning, Light, Earth

'Hmm? A Dryad at the Viscountess Rank?' Zhang Fei was surprised to see Janette's status; he didn't expect to meet a demon on Earth. 'But how did she get to Earth, Mei? Is there a portal to the Netherworld Realm on Earth? And also, you haven't explained the demon ranks to me.'

[The demon ranks? There are 10 demon ranks, Lesser, Knight/Lady, Baron/Baroness, Viscount/Viscountess, Earl/Countess, Marquis/Marchioness, Duke/Duchess, Archduke/Archduchess, King/Queen, Emperor/Empress] Mei stopped for a moment before continuing. [Anyway, no portals lead to the Netherworld Realm on Earth, but I discovered several portals lead to three other Realms on Earth.]
'Portals to the other three realms?' Zhang Fei was shocked to hear that. 'Do you know about the three realms?'

Mei immediately explained it to him. [According to the data from the system, the three realms are Diyu Realm, where low-class demons live. Tian Realm, where Winged Race humans live. And lastly, Xian Realm, where humans with supernatural powers reside. But I don't recommend you to go to those three realms, Master.
Because those three realms are not comparable to the Sky Jade Realm, Netherworld Realm, and Heavenly Moon Realm.]
'Hey, I still want to try going to those three realms.' Zhang Fei replied with a chuckle. Even though Mei said that, it didn't stop his interest in the three realms, causing her to sigh helplessly.
Zhang Fei then let go of his embrace, and he gently caressed Zhang Yue's cheek. "You have become even more beautiful after two years of not seeing you."

"Hehe." Zhang Yue giggled upon hearing that, then wiped her tears and caressed Zhang Fei's cheeks. "You've also become more handsome than two years ago. At first, I couldn't believe it when I saw the photo of you that Lin sent me, but it turns out you are much more handsome than your photo."
Zhang Yue looked at Ye Lian, Chu Ying, and Chu Qing. Then she asked with a hint of jealousy in her tone. "Anyway, are they really your wives, Fei?"

"En, Ying'er, and Qing'er are my wives, while Lian'er is still not my wife." Zhang Fei answered frankly because he had never hidden anything from Zhang Yue since they were little. Then he looked at Ru Xue and Zhong Yan. "Anyway, Xue'er is also my woman, and Yan'er is my future woman."
Zhang Yue was dumbfounded by his confession, then she looked at Ru Xue and Zhong Yan in disbelief. She had known them since childhood, but now, they were her little brother's women.
Ru Xue and Zhong Yan turned their blushing faces; they felt embarrassed towards Zhang Yue, as their family rank was below her now because Zhang Fei was her little brother.
Zhang Yue, with a dejected sigh, spoke again. "I didn't expect that you are now such a playboy, and you even have so many women."
"Big Brother still has a few more women, Big Sis!" Zhang Lin added with a chuckle.
Zhang Yue massaged her head as she felt dizzy because Zhang Fei had so many women, which made her feel disappointed and sad.

"I'll tell you everything later." Zhang Fei said, stroking Zhang Yue's long hair, and she just nodded to him, then he said as he looked at Janette. "All of you go into the house first; I want to talk to that woman alone."
"You can't be alone with her, Fei!" Zhang Yue shouted at him as she gripped Zhang Fei's hand tightly
Regarding Janette, Zhang Yue acted like a mother hen trying to protect her chicks because she knew her friend's character very well, so she didn't want Zhang Fei to have any relationship with her.
"You take it easy; I just wanted to talk to her about something." Zhang Fei said as he patted Zhang Yue's hand, then let go of her hand.
"But-"
"Just let Big Brother talk to her first, Big Sis." Zhang Lin said as she pulled Zhang Yue into the house.

Zhang Yue stared at Zhang Fei, who was walking towards Janette in confusion because she was sure he had never met her before, so she was confused as to why she wanted to talk to Janette alone. But she could only give up when Zhang Lin pulled her into the house, and she then looked at her little sister in bewilderment. 'How can Lin be strong like this? I can't even take my hand off hers.'
Qing Yi walked after them, as she said. "You don't have to worry about him, Yue'er. Because the current Fei'er is not the old him, he can take care of himself now."
"Yue'er, Your mother is right; the current Fei'er is reliable." Zhang Chen added as she walked into the house, and Zhang Yue nodded at her grandma.
Arriving in front of Janette, Zhang Fei said to her. "Follow me. I don't want my big sister to hear our conversation, Dryad."
Janette was shocked to hear his words and stared at him wide-eyed, but Zhang Fei didn't care about her gaze, and he walked away in another direction.
Janette gritted her teeth and walked after Zhang Fei, and she inwardly muttered. 'How did he know that I was a Dryad?'

chapters.title: Chapter 134: Talk With Janette
paragraphs: After arriving at a place without passerby, Zhang Fei turned to look at Janette and spoke to her. "Anyway, don't act weird in front of me, let alone use your Charm on me, because your Charm won't work on me. If I want to kill you, I can kill you anytime."

After Zhang Fei said that, he directly summoned Boitata from the Beast Space. She immediately coiled around his neck as she looked at Janette with fiery eyes. "Master, this demon is really weak, and she can't be compared to those cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm"

'Sky Jade Realm?' Janette was shocked to hear that Boitata could talk, and she could feel that Boitata was much stronger than her. Then she remembered what her ancestors said: that many beasts can understand humans well in the universe and are powerful. She then took a deep breath and carefully asked Zhang Fei. "What do you want to talk to me about?"

"What is your purpose in approaching Big Sis? And did you come from the Diyu Realm?" Zhang Fei asked bluntly because he wanted to make sure that Janette did not have any malicious intentions toward Zhang Yue, and he was also curious about the Diyu Realm.
