chapters.title: Chapter 135: With Zhang Yue I
paragraphs: Zhang Yue immediately ran to hug Zhang Fei's arm when she saw him walking into the house. Then she glared at Janette as she asked. "Is she trying to seduce you, Fei?"
Janette smiled faintly at Zhang Yue's question, and she just shook her head, then walked into the house.
"Why do you ask like that, Big Sis?" Zhang Fei asked amusedly because Zhang Yue seemed unwilling to see himself close to Janette, even though their relationship looked good.
Zhang Yue puffed out her cheeks and whispered very quietly. "Even though Janette is nice, she likes to toy with men's feelings, so I don't want you to get close to her."

"Hey, Big Sis! Big Brother even has a lot of women." Zhang Lin said as she laughed heartily; she felt Zhang Yue's attitude was too ridiculous for her. Moreover, she looked like a lover who was afraid of her lover being snatched away by another woman.
Zhang Yue was stunned, she just remembered that Zhang Fei had many women, and her expression turned sad again.
Zhang Fei inwardly sighed, then he pulled Zhang Yue into his room. "Come with me; I want to tell you many things."

Zhang Yue just nodded, and she let Zhang Fei lead her into his room, but then she was stunned to see the Portable Mansion in his room and asked in confusion. "Since when do you like collecting toys like this mansion?"
"Hehe! This Mansion isn't a toy; you'll understand once you enter it." After he said that, Zhang Fei led Zhang Yue into the Portable Mansion.
Inside the Mansion
-chapter

As soon as they entered it, Zhang Yue instantly froze. Her eyes widened in shock, and her mouth fell wide open. Her eyes kept glancing around the inside of the Mansion; she was shocked to see the inside, which was so big, spacious, and luxurious. Before long, she screamed in shock. "What the hell!? How is this possible?"
Zhang Fei laughed at her reaction, then he said with a laugh. "Hehe, I already told you my mansion is not a toy, but mine is real, and we can live in it."

"But how is this possible? Your Mansion looks like a toy from the outside, but the inside is so spacious, big, and too luxurious!" Zhang Yue spoke, still in shock, and she walked around the Mansion's first floor, her hands touching every piece of furniture. "Did you meet Doraemon? Because your Mansion is unbelievable, and only he can do it!"

Zhang Fei was dumbfounded by Zhang Yue's question. At first, he thought that she would bombard him with other questions, but he didn't expect that she would ask such a ridiculous question, and he remembered that his big sister was indeed a big fan of Doraemon; then he said with a laugh. "Haha! He is just a cartoon character, so how can I possibly meet him?"

"Hehe." Zhang Yue giggled; she naturally knew that, but she couldn't think of anything else because Zhang Fei's Mansion was too weird for her. Then she looked at him and asked suspiciously. "So, where did you get this mansion?"

"I really can't tell you, Big Sis." Zhang Fei said as he scratched his head because he had never hidden anything against Zhang Yue all this time, but now he had to hide the existence of Mei and the system from her.
"Humph!-"
*Tap... Tap...*
Zhang Yue had yet to get angry with him, and two women were already walking towards them as they called out to Zhang Fei. "Master!"

Zhang Yue immediately raised her eyebrows when she saw the two women in sexy maid clothes, then she turned to Zhang Fei questioningly and felt very jealous because he had so many women beside him. "Who are they? Why are they both here? Moreover, they are wearing sexy maid outfits like that."
"They are my maids, Shi Xi and Shi Wu, so they live in this mansion." Zhang Fei answered her, and he then turned to them. "She is my big sister, Zhang Yue."
"Nice to meet you." Shi Xi and Shi Wu greeted Zhang Yue in unison.
"En." Zhang Yue nodded to them as she continued to observe their faces. 'Sigh, Fei is such a playboy! But all his women are so beautiful; even these two are no less beautiful than the others.'
"Are you two comfortable living here?" Zhang Fei asked.
They nodded to him, and Shi Wu answered him. "We are used to living in small houses, and this is the first time we have lived in a luxurious mansion, so we feel comfortable here, master."
"En." Shi Xi nodded in agreement with her sister. "Moreover, the food available in the kitchen is also very unique and delicious, which makes us even more comfortable here."

"Oh?" Zhang Fei was surprised upon hearing that; he had seen a lot of food in the kitchen but had never tried to taste them. "Well, you guys can go back to your places now; I want to talk to my Big Sis first."
"Yes, Master." They immediately left, leaving Zhang Fei and Zhang Yue alone.

Zhang Fei then turned to Zhang Yue and looked her directly in the eyes, making her blush. Before long, he sighed softly and made up his mind. "Besides this mansion, there are a few other things I want to tell you, Big Sis."
Zhang Yue looked at Zhang Fei in confusion and felt that her little brother's attitude was very strange. "What do you want to tell me?"
Zhang Fei took a step back, then turned into an incubus, shocking Zhang Yue.

Zhang Yue's eyes widened in shock, and her body trembled. She stretched out her hand, touched his horns, and rubbed his cheek as she stuttered. "What... what happened to you, Fei!? How... how did you become a demon like this?"

"It's a long story." Zhang Fei then told her about the accident that happened to him, which changed his life drastically. He also told her about cultivators, demons, the Sky Jade Realm, and many others. "And one more thing, I have already killed Zhang He and Chen Xin."

chapters.title: Chapter 136: With Zhang Yue II
paragraphs: "It's a long story." Zhang Fei then told her about the accident that happened to him, which changed his life drastically. He also told her about cultivators, demons, the Sky Jade Realm, and many others. "And one more thing, I have already killed Zhang He and Chen Xin."

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to her, then he explained it to her. "Zhang He teamed up with several people to kidnap my good friend, Guo Lan. And they also tried to kill me, so I killed them all."

Zhang Yue immediately slumped down on the sofa behind her, and she looked at Zhang Fei in complete shock. Even though she hated Zhang He, he was their eldest brother, and now her little brother had killed him. She then buried her face into her palm, and she sadly muttered. "Why did everything become like this? Why do we as a family have to kill each other?"

Zhang Fei walked to Zhang Yue and knelt before her as he held her hand. "I didn't want anything like this to happen, but I was forced to kill Zhang He. Since he tried to kill me first, and if I don't kill him, then I will be the one to die by his hands."
"Did grandma and the others know about this, Fei?" Zhang Yue asked poignantly.
Zhang Fei nodded to her. "Grandma, Mom, and Lin already know I killed Zhang He. And only Zhang Hai doesn't know about this yet."

Zhang Yue kept staring at Zhang Fei; she really felt complicated in her heart. She knew their eldest brother was bad, but she still regretted his death. Moreover, he died at the hands of their youngest brother.

However, if Zhang Yue had to choose between them, then without a doubt, she would choose their eldest brother, who had to die. Because in her heart, Zhang Fei is much more important than their eldest brother, and she doesn't want to lose him.

Zhang Yue then caressed Zhang Fei's cheek as she continued to look at him sadly and regretfully, she had not been by his side for the past two years, and too many things had happened to him during these two years. "I'm really sorry, Fei. If only-"

"You don't have to regret it because I've never regretted becoming a demon, Big Sis." Zhang Fei instantly covered Zhang Yue's mouth with his hand. "Moreover, not only me but all of them are already cultivators, and I will also teach you how to cultivate later. Since cultivators can live very long, we can live together for a long time."

Zhang Yue continued to stare at him in disbelief. Like Zhang Fei, she was also a fan of novels, one of which was novels about cultivators and the like. In her eyes, cultivators were only fiction and not real, but now her little brother had told her that he and their family had become cultivators, and it was hard for her to believe his words.

"I know you must have a hard time believing my words." Zhang Fei softly said, then she pulled his hand from Zhang Yue's mouth, and showed his Fire Qi to her. "This is my Fire Qi, Big Sis. Lin'er has Water Qi, Mom has Wind Qi, and Grandma has Light Qi."
"Unbelievable!" Zhang Yue muttered as her eyes continued to observe the Fire Qi in Zhang Fei's hand.
"Do you believe my words now?" Zhang Fei asked with a gentle smile; Zhang Yue just nodded to him, then he retracted his Fire Qi. "There's one more thing I want to show you."

Zhang Yue's eyes widened again when she saw Zhang Fei turn into a little white fox, then she lifted him off the floor and placed him on her lap. She then stroked the little fox's head as she asked softly. "How can you also become a fox like this?"
"My circumstances are a bit unique, Big Sis. I'm still fully human, an incubus, and a fox beast." Zhang Fei replied.
Zhang Yue immediately burst out laughing when Zhang Fei answered her; she felt it was terrific to hear a fox can talk; then she picked him up and kissed his fox mouth for a moment.
Zhang Fei was speechless, even though he was still in the form of a fox, but the fox was still him, and it was his first time kissing his big sister.
"Hehe, I really can't stand your cuteness, Fei. Because your fox form is too cute." Zhang Yue said with a bashful expression, and her cheeks were bright red.
Zhang Fei jumped down from her embrace and returned to his human form, then he pushed Zhang Yue against the back of the sofa and kissed her lips directly.
Zhang Yue was shocked by his action, but she didn't want to push him away. Instead, she wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei's neck and kissed him back instantly as she closed her eyes.

Getting a positive reaction from his big sister, Zhang Fei stuck his tongue into her mouth. Zhang Yue, who felt it, immediately opened her mouth as she also stuck out her tongue to greet his. Their tongues intertwined, and they continued to dance together as they moved around into each other's mouths.
Zhang Fei only kissed Zhang Yue without doing anything else, and the longer their kiss, became more passionate.
A few minutes later, Zhang Fei parted their lips, caressed her cheek, and looked at his big sister affectionately.

Zhang Yue also looked at him affectionately as she caressed his cheek. Although she found kissing her little brother strange, she couldn't deny that she enjoyed kissing him. Then she asked seriously. "Can you tell me how many women you have now? And who are they?"
Zhang Fei smiled, picked up Zhang Yue, carried her to the room, and laid her on the bed.
Zhang Yue's face turned red; she laid her head on her chest and listened to Zhang Fei tell her about many things, especially his experiences after the accident.

Only his Heavenly Body Tempering had already advanced to the second stage, Bronze Body.

Liu Hua and Wen Twins sitting together on the roof of a two-story building, they continued to observe people walking in and out of the building, and the people seemed enthusiastic to shop for things they had never seen before especially all those mattresses.
"This is the Profound Elemental Fruit, Big Sis." Wen Yuan suddenly said as she handed Liu Hua a five-colored fruit. "As for the Blood Spirit Grass, they will immediately send it here."
"En, good." Liu Hua nodded as she accepted a five-colored fruit and stored it in her storage ring. "Fei'er's elemental power can increase greatly with this Profound Elemental Fruit."
"Anyway, those mattresses are almost sold out, Big Sis." Wen Xuan said. "It's been two days since Zhang Fei returned to his realm; maybe our stock won't be enough to serve those buyers."
"En, I know, Xuan'er." Liu Hua said with a low sigh. "Anyway, what about Huan Ning? And is there any movement from the Li Clan?"
"No." Wen Yuan answered her with a shake of her head. "Huan Ning has never left the Zhao Clan, and it seems that Zhang Fei has done something to her, which makes her look depressed."

"As for the Li Clan, Li Jue and Li Bao didn't do anything, and they always stayed in his clan." Wen Xuan added. "However, Mei Xiang and Li Lian repeatedly watched us, but I didn't do anything to them."
"I see." Liu Hua nodded in understanding, looked up at the sky, and asked softly. "Aren't you going to come down? I know you've been watching us for a long time."
"Huh!?" The Wen twins were surprised to hear Liu Hua's words because they didn't feel anyone was watching them, so they looked up at the sky.
Soon, a woman with long white hair wearing a white floral dress flew down slowly and landed right in front of them.

"Who are you? And what is your purpose in keeping an eye on us?" Liu Hua calmly asked. Even so, she became wary of the woman; she could sense she was much stronger than her mother. 'How is this possible? How could there be a woman stronger than my mother in this region? Could she possibly come from the central region?'

The white-haired woman smiled faintly and spoke to her. "Little girl, you don't need to be so wary of me; I don't want to do anything to you guys. I can smell that male fox on you, so I decided to keep an eye on you."
"Male Fox?" In confusion, Liu Hua raised her eyebrows, but then she remembered that Zhang Fei was a fox.
"En, his name is Zhang Fei." The woman replied with a nod and introduced herself to Liu Hua. "Anyway, my name is Hu Lili, and I am Hu Yue's mother."

"Hu Yue?" Liu Hua was surprised to hear that, as she remembered Hu Yue, the female fox who made Zhang Fei impatient to increase his cultivation. "So you're a woman from the Moon Fox Clan? No wonder your cultivation is above my mother's. But what did you come here for?"
"I came here to meet that Zhang Fei, but it seems he's not here." Hu Lili herself had heard Wen Xuan's words earlier that he was returning to his realm. "Can I ask you one thing about him?"
"Oh? You can ask me." Liu Hua said with a nod; she was relieved that she didn't feel any ill will from Hu Lili.
"Do you know about Zhang Fei's fox race?" Hu Lili asked without beating around the bush.
However, Liu Hua shook her head. "Frankly speaking, I don't know Zhang Fei's fox race myself, and he never told me about his fox race either."
"Have you ever seen his fox form?" Liu Hua nodded to her. "Can I look into your memories of his fox form?"
"Sure."

Hu Lili then reached out her hand to touch Liu Hua's forehead, and her eyes shone brightly. Before long, she withdrew her hand as she muttered. "My guess is correct; he really is a Heavenly Fox, and his features are like the ones in the legends."
"Heavenly Fox?" Li Hua and the Wen twins were shocked to hear that.

"En." Hu Lili nodded to them, and she explained. "Heavenly Fox is a sacred race of the fox races; they stand above all the fox races that exist today. They are very proud, arrogant, cunning, and cruel. But they have a great ability to sustain their character, and they are the only fox race that can through space and time."
"Space and Time?" They were shocked to hear Hu Lili's words, then Liu Hua asked. "Are you looking for Zhang Fei because of your daughter?"

Hu Lili nodded to her. "Yes! Yue'er already told me about Zhang Fei's promise to her, so I came here to confirm his true identity, and it turned out that I was right that he was a Heavenly Fox. This way, I am sure he will be able to keep his promise to my daughter."
Hua Lili then took out a necklace and gave it to Liu Hua. "Give this necklace to Zhang Fei; he can use this necklace to enter our place without any problems later."
After that, Hu Lili instantly disappeared from their sight.
"Moon Fox Race, Huh? They are powerful and definitely the strongest in this Sky Jade Realm." Liu Hua muttered to herself with a sigh.
